description: This file defines a SwiftUI view named PermissionsSettings, which manages and displays various permission settings related to location, notifications, and system access within an application. It includes subviews for location access and permission status listing, as well as UI components for granting permissions and refreshing their status.

classes.name: PermissionsSettings
classes.description: Main view handling overall permissions UI, including notification, location, and system capabilities.

classes.name: LocationAccessSettings
classes.description: Subview managing location permission options and authorization requests.

classes.name: PermissionStatusList
classes.description: Subview displaying and refreshing the status of various capabilities.

classes.name: PermissionRow
classes.description: Component representing individual permission status with actions to request or display granted status.

methods.name: requestLocationAuthorization
methods.description: Asynchronously requests location permission based on the selected mode.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles permission requests for specific capabilities and refreshes status.

methods.name: refreshStatusTransitions
methods.description: Refreshes permission statuses multiple times with delays to allow system settings to settle.
